task_instance: Given a small sample TypeScript repo (package.json with pnpm scripts, pnpm-lock.yaml, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/architecture.md, SECURITY.md, src/), inspect it and generate a concise root AGENTS.md following the skill's workflow and template, then symlink CLAUDE.md to it as a Claude-compatible entrypoint.
evidence: Created sample repo at sample-repo/ with package.json (pnpm scripts: build/test/lint), pnpm-lock.yaml, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/architecture.md, SECURITY.md, src/index.ts + test. Inspected these per the skill's 'Inspect before writing' step, then wrote sample-repo/AGENTS.md (24 lines, well under the 60-line target) using the skill's Default Sections template: Package Manager, Commands table, External References table, Commit Attribution. Verified every referenced command and path exists (pnpm build/test/lint match package.json scripts; CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/architecture.md, SECURITY.md all present). Ran `ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md` in the repo root and confirmed via `readlink -f CLAUDE.md` and `cat CLAUDE.md` that it resolves to and reads identically to AGENTS.md, satisfying the File Setup step ('symlink CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md; do not maintain divergent copies'). No external tools, network access, or credentials were needed -- the entire task is local file inspection and Markdown authoring.
